export {}

MetaFor("invalid-mass-function")
  .fields(() => ({}))
  .superposition({})
  .mass((mass) => ({
    // @ts-expect-error Mass contains material, not executable functions
    execute: () => true,
    // @ts-expect-error nullable union still contains an executable function
    optionalExecute: null as null | (() => boolean),
    // @ts-expect-error Map is not serializable Mass
    profiles: new Map<string, { id: string }>(),
    // @ts-expect-error a live WebSocket belongs to Energy
    socket: null as unknown as WebSocket,
    // @ts-expect-error a nested function is not serializable Mass
    nested: { execute: () => true },
  }))

MetaFor("strict-generated-contract")
  .fields((field) => ({
    command: field.string.optional(),
    mode: field.enum("idle", "active").required("idle"),
    attempts: field.number.required(0),
    enabled: field.boolean.required(false),
    topology: field.array.required([]),
    error: field.string.optional(),
  }))
  .superposition({
    idle: {
      active: {
        command: { null: false },
        mode: { eq: "active" },
      },
      mixed: {
        command: { null: false },
      },
    },
    retry: {
      active: {
        command: { null: false },
      },
      mixed: {},
    },
    active: { done: {} },
    mixed: { done: {} },
    done: null,
  })
  .mass((mass) => ({
    attempts: mass.json(),
    profile: mass.json(),
  }))
  .energy<{
    channel: BroadcastChannel
    socket: WebSocket
  }>()
  .processes((process, destroy) => [
    process("active", { env: ["server"] })
      .action(async ({ energy, field, mass, self, signal, value }) => {
        void energy.channel
        void field.command
        void mass.attempts
        void self.atom
        void signal.aborted
        return {profileId: value.command ?? "", attempts: 1}
      })
      .success(({ data, update }) => {
        const profileId: string = data.profileId
        const attempts: number = data.attempts
        update({ attempts, mode: "active" })
        void profileId

        // @ts-expect-error action result keeps its exact inferred shape
        data.missing
        // @ts-expect-error Update accepts only declared Field keys
        update({ missing: 1 })
        // @ts-expect-error Update value must match the declared Field
        update({ attempts: data.profileId })
      })
      .error(({ error, update }) => {
        const message: string = error.message
        update({ error: message })

        // @ts-expect-error error branch receives Error, not success data
        error.profileId
      }),
    process("active").action(async ({ field }) => {
      const mod = await import("./actions/probe.ts")
      // @ts-expect-error action field contains only declared Fields
      return mod.default(field.missing)
    }),
    process("active").action(async ({ value }) => {
      const mod = await import("./actions/probe.ts")
      // @ts-expect-error action value contains only declared Values
      return mod.default(value.missing)
    }),
    process("active").action(async ({ mass }) => {
      const mod = await import("./actions/probe.ts")
      // @ts-expect-error Mass does not receive Energy keys
      return mod.default(mass.socket)
    }),
    process("active").action(async ({ energy }) => {
      const mod = await import("./actions/probe.ts")
      // @ts-expect-error Energy does not receive Mass keys
      return mod.default(energy.attempts)
    }),
    process("mixed").action(async ({ value }) => {
      const mod = await import("./actions/probe.ts")
      // @ts-expect-error mixed incoming waves keep the optional value nullable
      return mod.default(value.command satisfies string)
    }),
    destroy("done", { env: ["server"] }).before(async ({ energy, mass }) => {
      void energy.channel
      void mass.attempts
    }),
    destroy("done").before(async ({ mass }) => {
      const mod = await import("./actions/probe.ts")
      // @ts-expect-error destroy keeps exact Mass without Energy keys
      return mod.default(mass.socket)
    }),
    destroy("done").before(async ({ energy }) => {
      const mod = await import("./actions/probe.ts")
      // @ts-expect-error destroy keeps exact Energy without Mass keys
      return mod.default(energy.attempts)
    }),
  ])
  .reactions((reaction) => [[
    ["idle", "retry"],
    reaction({
      key: "remember",
      mass: {read: ["attempts"], write: ["attempts"]},
    })
      .filter([{meta: "owner/sensor", states: ["ready"]}])
      .equal(({mass, observation, self, state, update, value}) => {
        const sourceState: string = observation.source.state
        const targetState: "idle" | "retry" | "active" | "mixed" | "done" = state
        void mass.attempts
        void self.atom
        void sourceState
        void targetState
        update({attempts: value.attempts + 1})

        // @ts-expect-error Reaction cannot write topology Fields
        update({mode: "active"})
        // @ts-expect-error Reaction receives no previous source State
        observation.previous
        // @ts-expect-error Reaction receives no Force Particle
        observation.part
        // @ts-expect-error Reaction Mass contains only declared Mass keys
        mass.socket
      }),
  ]])
  .matter(({ energy, html, mass, state, update, value }) => {
    const currentState: "idle" | "retry" | "active" | "mixed" | "done" = state
    const currentMode: "idle" | "active" = value.mode
    const attempts = mass.attempts
    const socket: WebSocket = energy.socket
    update({ attempts: 1 })
    void currentState
    void currentMode
    void socket
    void attempts

    // @ts-expect-error Matter Mass does not receive Energy keys
    mass.socket
    // @ts-expect-error Matter Energy does not receive Mass keys
    energy.attempts

    return html`<meta-for
      src="owner/project-child"
      mass=${mass}
      energy=${energy}
    />`
  })
  .bulk({ view: ({ css }) => css`` })

MetaFor("invalid-enum-default").fields((field) => ({
  // @ts-expect-error enum default must be one of its literal values
  mode: field.enum("idle", "active").required("missing"),
}))

MetaFor("invalid-energy-function")
  .fields(() => ({}))
  .superposition({})
  .mass(() => ({}))
  // @ts-expect-error Energy declares entities, not functions or factories
  .energy<{ connect: () => WebSocket }>()

MetaFor("invalid-energy-object")
  .fields(() => ({}))
  .superposition({})
  .mass(() => ({}))
  // @ts-expect-error Energy is a generic type declaration, not a runtime object
  .energy({ socket: null as unknown as WebSocket })

MetaFor("invalid-process-state")
  .fields(() => ({}))
  .superposition({ idle: null })
  .mass(() => ({}))
  .energy()
  .processes((process, destroy) => [
    // @ts-expect-error process state must be declared by Superposition
    process("missing").action(() => ({})),
    // @ts-expect-error destroy state must be declared by Superposition
    destroy("missing"),
  ])

MetaFor("invalid-target")
  .fields((field) => ({ name: field.string.optional() }))
  // @ts-expect-error transition target must be a declared state
  .superposition({ idle: { missing: {} } })

MetaFor("invalid-wave-field")
  .fields((field) => ({ name: field.string.optional() }))
  // @ts-expect-error transition wave may use only declared Fields
  .superposition({ idle: { ready: { missing: { eq: "value" } } }, ready: null })

MetaFor("invalid-condition-operator")
  .fields((field) => ({ name: field.string.optional() }))
  // @ts-expect-error condition operator must belong to the Field type
  .superposition({ idle: { ready: { name: { unknown: true } } }, ready: null })

MetaFor("invalid-enum-condition")
  .fields((field) => ({ mode: field.enum("idle", "active").required("idle") }))
  // @ts-expect-error enum condition keeps the declared literal union
  .superposition({ idle: { ready: { mode: { eq: "missing" } } }, ready: null })

MetaFor("invalid-self-transition")
  .fields((field) => ({ requested: field.boolean.required(false) }))
  // @ts-expect-error self-transition is forbidden even when it has a Field guard
  .superposition({ idle: { idle: { requested: { eq: true } } } })
